title: 第3章我的金手指竟是你第4章练气期二层
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙
content_zh:
;;
北寒风心中一惊，下意识地伸手按住跳动的红皮葫芦。
这红皮葫芦随他穿越而来，期间发现除了结实耐用、盛酒不易变味外，从未有过任何特异之处。
今日初入这废丹院，怎会如此异动？
他浑浊的双眼警惕地扫视了一圈四周，除了废丹院内两间一大一小木屋和空气中若有若无的焦糊霉味外，似乎并无任何异常
待红皮葫芦不再跳动，北寒风推开篱笆门，迈步踏入了废丹院内。
他没在院内多停留，而是直接走向了离大屋不远的小屋。
推开木板门，进入小屋。
屋内陈设很简陋，一床，一桌，一凳，桌上还放着一个粗陶水罐和一只碗。
走到凳子前坐下，北寒风从怀里拿出《长春功》和身份玉牌。
将玉牌放在桌上，然后翻开《长春功》。
长春功分为上下两部分。
上部分记载着修仙界的一些常规知识，如丹药等级，修行境界，灵根划分等。
下部分则记载着怎么修炼的法门，如怎么感应天地灵气，怎么引导灵气入体，怎么运转灵气。
不过上面也标注着该功法最多只能修炼到练气期十二层大圆满。如想要修到筑基期，金丹期，甚至更上的元婴期只能再换功法。
北寒风看得很入神，直到屋外传来脚步声，才抬起头。
一名穿着灰色杂役服的年轻弟子站在门没关的门口，脸上带着几分好奇，打量着他。
“北……北师兄，”那弟子犹豫了一下，还是叫出了师兄二字，不管怎么说，眼前之人都是内门弟子，该有的尊敬还是要有的。
“这是您这个月的份例。”
他递过来一个小布袋。

北寒风起身走来接过，入手颇轻。打开一看，里面有十颗圆形白色丹药和一颗散发着淡淡清香的蓝色丹药。
“白色丹药为下品辟谷丹，每月十颗，服一颗可顶三日饥渴。”杂役弟子解释道，又指了指那蓝色丹药，“这是一颗下品练气丹，助益修行用的。”
北寒风浑浊的眼睛在练气丹上多停留了片刻，点了点头，沙哑道：“有劳。”
杂役弟子对北寒风行了一礼，便转身走了。
北寒风将布袋放在桌上，目光落在练气丹上。
练气丹。
他记得刚看过的《长春功》杂闻篇里有提及，炼气期修士常用的丹药，能辅助凝聚灵气，加快修炼速度。
拿起练气丹闻了闻，一股清淡的灵气传来，精神顿时一震。
不愧是属于修仙用的丹药，虽然只是下品练气丹药，但就刚刚那一闻，就感觉精神好了很多。
北寒风重新塞把练气丹放回布袋，打算先把《长春功》记熟，再进行服用。
他目光扫视一圈屋内。
屋内狭小，似乎并无储物之处，目光最终落在了腰间的红皮葫芦上。
这和他一起穿越的红葫芦，容量不大，但胜在密封尚可。他平日都是用其盛酒喝的，今日倒是要换下用途了。
解开系着葫芦的黄绳，拔开木塞，北寒风将里面残余的一些酒水倒尽。
然后，他拿起练气丹轻轻放入了葫芦中，重新盖好，挂回腰间。
做完这一切，他才拿起一颗辟谷丹，吞进了肚子。
辟谷丹一入腹就有一股微弱的暖流在体内散开，昨日至今滴水不沾的饥饿感瞬间消退。
“仙家之物，果然玄妙！”北寒风低声自语了一句，随后继续翻阅《长春功》。
……
接下来的几日，北寒风的生活极其规律。

每日清晨，他便起身，拿着屋内找到的扫帚，慢慢清扫着废丹院落里积攒的落叶与尘土。
扫完地，他便回到小屋，研读《长春功》，并尝试按照法诀所述，感应天地灵气。
过程与预想中一样艰难。
他这具身体，如同干涸龟裂的河床，经脉萎缩堵塞得很严重。

Bei Hanfeng was startled and subconsciously stretched out his hand to hold down the beating red gourd.
This red-skinned gourd traveled with him through time, and he discovered that it had never had anything special about it, except that it was durable and would not easily change flavor when used to hold wine.
It was the first time I entered the Abandoned Pill Academy today. Why did it happen so strangely?
His turbid eyes scanned the surroundings vigilantly. Except for the two large and small wooden houses in the Waste Pill Courtyard and the faint smell of burnt musty in the air, there seemed to be nothing unusual.
When the red-skinned gourd stopped beating, Bei Hanfeng pushed open the fence door and stepped into the Feidan Courtyard.
He did not stay in the courtyard for long, but went directly to the small house not far from the big house.
Push open the wooden door and enter the hut.
The furnishings in the house are very simple, with a bed, a table, a stool, and a stoneware pitcher and a bowl on the table.
Walking to the stool and sitting down, Bei Hanfeng took out the "Changchun Gong" and the identity jade token from his arms.
Place the jade tablet on the table and open the "Eternal Spring Gong".
Changchun Gong is divided into upper and lower parts.
The upper part records some common knowledge in the world of immortality, such as the level of elixirs, realm of cultivation, division of spiritual roots, etc.
The lower part records how to practice, such as how to sense the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, how to guide the spiritual energy into the body, and how to circulate the spiritual energy.
However, it is also marked on it that this technique can only be practiced up to the twelfth level of Dzogchen in the Qi training period. If you want to cultivate to the foundation building stage, golden elixir stage, or even the Nascent Soul stage, you can only change the exercises.
Bei Hanfeng was fascinated by what he saw. He didn't raise his head until he heard footsteps outside the house.
A young disciple wearing a gray uniform stood at the door, which was open, looking at him with a bit of curiosity on his face.
"Senior Brother Bei...Senior Brother Bei," the disciple hesitated for a moment, but still called out the word "Senior Brother." No matter what, the person in front of him was an inner disciple, and he still had to have the respect he deserved.
"This is your share for the month."
He handed over a small cloth bag.
Bei Hanfeng stood up and walked over to take it, taking it lightly. When he opened it, he found ten round white elixirs and one blue elixir that exuded a light fragrance.
"The white pill is a low-grade Bigu Pill. Ten pills are taken every month. One pill can quench hunger and thirst for three days." The handyman disciple explained and pointed to the blue pill. "This is a low-grade Qi Training Pill, which is used to help practice."
Bei Hanfeng's turbid eyes stayed on the Qi Training Pill for a moment longer, nodded, and said hoarsely: "Thank you."
The handyman disciple saluted Bei Hanfeng, then turned and left.
Bei Hanfeng placed the cloth bag on the table and his eyes fell on the Qi Training Pill.
Qi training pill.
He remembered that the miscellaneous chapter of "Changchun Gong" he had just read mentioned that elixirs commonly used by monks during the Qi refining stage can help condense spiritual energy and speed up cultivation.
Picking up the Qi Training Pill and smelling it, a light spiritual energy came through, and his spirit was suddenly shaken.
It is indeed a pill for cultivating immortals. Although it is only a low-grade Qi-training pill, I felt much better the moment I smelled it.
Bei Hanfeng put the Qi Training Pill back into the bag again, intending to memorize the Changchun Gong before taking it.
He glanced around the room.
The room was small, and there seemed to be no storage space. His eyes finally fell on the red leather gourd on his waist.
The red gourd that traveled with him didn't have a large capacity, but it was sealed well. He usually uses it to hold wine, but today he has to use it for a different purpose.
Untied the yellow rope that tied the gourd, pulled out the cork, and the cold north wind poured out some of the remaining wine inside.
Then, he picked up the Qi Training Pill and gently put it into the gourd, covered it again, and hung it back on his waist.
After doing all this, he picked up a Bigu Pill and swallowed it.
As soon as Bigu Pill enters the abdomen, a weak warm current spreads in the body, and the hunger that has not been touched since yesterday subsides instantly.
"The things of the immortal family are indeed mysterious!" Bei Hanfeng whispered to himself, and then continued to read "Changchun Gong".
…
In the next few days, Bei Hanfeng's life was extremely regular.
EveryEarly that morning, he got up, took the broom he found in the house, and slowly swept away the fallen leaves and dust accumulated in the Feidan courtyard.
After sweeping the floor, he returned to the hut, studied the Changchun Gong, and tried to sense the aura of heaven and earth according to the instructions.
The process was as difficult as expected.
His body was like a dry and cracked river bed, and his meridians were severely atrophied and blocked.
